## Equity Futures Rise Ahead of July CPI; CoreWeave and Nebius Lead AI-Driven Premarket Moves

A hot or sticky CPI print could undercut the rates-sensitive AI capex narrative driving premarket strength; PM should watch whether AI names hold gains after the CPI release or fade if inflation surprises to the upside.

- S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 futures pointed higher in premarket trading.
- July CPI print is the key macro event of the session.
- CRWV and NBIS are specifically named for AI-driven premarket outperformance.
- Super Micro also cited in the headline, though the reference was truncated.
- Macro and AI-sector moves are in play simultaneously, making the CPI outcome pivotal for whether premarket gains hold.
